name: Public site routes
description: Verifies the published site has independent navigable page surfaces rather than only section anchors.
expected: Each destination loads its own page surface and changes the URL to the selected route.

name: Mobile navigation
description: Verifies the site structure remains usable on small screens.
steps: Move focus to the next control
expected: The menu opens, Work loads, and focus remains visibly indicated.

name: Inquiry brief
description: Verifies the contact surface creates a structured inquiry brief without claiming server submission.
steps: Enter a problem and desired outcome
expected: A readable brief appears and no server submission is claimed.

name: 404 recovery
description: Verifies an unknown path resolves to an intentional recoverable no-signal state.
expected: The NEXUS 404 state appears with a path back to home.

name: Reduced motion
description: Verifies internal pages do not depend on animation for comprehension.
steps: Open Method with reduced motion enabled
expected: Content remains available and usable without required animation.
